correctness.rationale: The rational denominator has no eigenvalue zero on the generator spectrum. Taylor/Jordan functional calculus gives all transient entries and row conservation gives every absorption entry. A rigorously derived sine/Chebyshev generating function yields exact signs; positivity is equivalent to theta>=pi/12 and (n-1)theta<=pi, with n=2 treated separately. Endpoints, zero step, all n and all positive h are covered. A standard-library exact Fraction matrix solver independently verified 27,584 assertions for n=2..18 at twelve rational steps. Finite cases are not used to prove the universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: The complete natural finite-state classification yields a sharp 13-versus-14 existence cutoff and exact safe windows for every chain length, extending beyond the known n=8 witness. The precise maximum feasible length and exceptional single-step n=13 boundary are mathematically motivated by positivity requirements for conservative Markov time discretization and support algorithmic timestep feasibility decisions. This is not a cosmetic refinement of an already published interval, and no broader theorem is required for the self-contained classification.
